parts.zh: W: 我得说，我太喜欢我们的食堂了！那里真是个很棒的碰面地点！
M: 是啊，对学生和老师来说确实都是这样
W: 你这是什么意思？我觉得食物还不错啊
M: 我觉得食物只能算还行
W: 其实我不这么认为
W: 嗯，是的，甜点确实定价过高
M: 是啊，那些炒鸡蛋很好吃
W: 完全同意，而且那里的环境也特别好
W: 那些巨大的玻璃窗让整个地方完全不一样

items.stem: What does the woman say about the food at the canteen?

choices.text: It is absurdly expensive.
choices.zh: 价格高得离谱。

choices.text: It is appropriately priced.
choices.zh: 定价合理。

choices.text: It brings shame on the university.
choices.zh: 给大学丢脸。

choices.text: It caters to students and teachers.
choices.zh: 面向学生和教师提供服务。

items.stem: How does the woman feel about the canteen's sweet things or fancy delicacies?

choices.text: They never really appeal to her.
choices.zh: 它们从来都不太吸引她。

choices.text: They are never actually good value.
choices.zh: 它们从来都不太物有所值。

choices.text: They are within students' budgets.
choices.zh: 它们在学生的预算范围内。

choices.text: They always come at a high speed.
choices.zh: 它们总是来得很快。

items.stem: What does the man say is one of the best things about the canteen?

choices.text: The food.
choices.zh: 食物。

choices.text: The space.
choices.zh: 空间。

choices.text: The speed.
choices.zh: 速度。

choices.text: The environment.
choices.zh: 环境。

items.stem: What did the canteen undergo a few years ago?

choices.text: A complete refurnishing.
choices.zh: 全面重新装修。

choices.text: A ruinous burning down.
choices.zh: 毁灭性的火灾。

choices.text: A substantial expansion.
choices.zh: 大规模扩建。

choices.text: A massive renovation.
choices.zh: 大规模翻新。

items.stem: According to the woman, what view about today's young people is not really justified?

choices.text: They have a poor work ethic.
choices.zh: 他们的职业道德很差。

choices.text: They don't get along with managers.
choices.zh: 他们与管理者相处不好。

choices.text: They are struggling in the workplace.
choices.zh: 他们在职场中举步维艰。

choices.text: They aren't as varied as their predecessors.
choices.zh: 他们不如前辈那样多样化。

items.stem: What does the man say is important for managers to get along better with young workers?

choices.text: Learning about the way they adhere to their own values.
choices.zh: 了解他们坚持自己价值观的方式。

choices.text: Recognizing how they try to strike a work-life balance.
choices.zh: 认识到他们如何努力实现工作与生活的平衡。

choices.text: Knowing how they struggle to connect with managers.
choices.zh: 知道他们如何努力与管理者建立联系。

choices.text: Understanding the way they seek career advancement.
choices.zh: 理解他们寻求职业发展的方式。

items.stem: How do young people measure their productivity levels according to the man?

choices.text: In terms of the number of hours spent.
choices.zh: 根据花费的小时数。

choices.text: By the amount of work they perform.
choices.zh: 根据他们完成的工作量。

choices.text: In terms of the work done in 8 hours.
choices.zh: 根据8小时内完成的工作。

choices.text: By the quality of the work they do.
choices.zh: 根据他们所做工作的质量。

items.stem: What companies does the man think would appeal to young workers?

choices.text: Those whose culture facilitates their advancement.
choices.zh: 那些其文化有助于他们晋升的公司。

choices.text: Those allowing them to do projects of their choice.
choices.zh: 那些允许他们做自己选择的项目的公司。

choices.text: Those whose values align with their own.
choices.zh: 那些其价值观与他们自己的价值观一致的公司。

choices.text: Those refraining from discrediting their perspectives.
choices.zh: 那些避免贬低他们观点的公司。

items.stem: What does a new study suggest about restaurants including vegetarian sections on their menus?

choices.text: They may unconsciously help customers choose greener dishes.
choices.zh: 它们可能会无意识地帮助顾客选择更环保的菜品。

choices.text: They may unintentionally encourage customers to eat meat.
choices.zh: 它们可能会无意中鼓励顾客吃肉。

choices.text: They raise customers' environmental awareness.
choices.zh: 它们提高了顾客的环保意识。

choices.text: They enable customers to eat in a healthy way.
choices.zh: 它们使顾客能够以健康的方式进食。

items.stem: How was the study carried out on 750 participants?

choices.text: By inviting them to taste different kinds of food.
choices.zh: 通过邀请他们品尝不同种类的食物。

choices.text: By observing the eating behavior of strict vegetarians.
choices.zh: 通过观察严格素食者的饮食行为。

choices.text: By comparing participants eating vegetarian food frequently with those doing so rarely.
choices.zh: 通过比较经常食用素食的参与者与很少这样做的参与者。

choices.text: By requiring participants to choose a meal as if they were feasting at a family gathering.
choices.zh: 通过要求参与者选择一餐,就好像他们正在家庭聚会上用餐一样。

items.stem: How do altered menu designs affect frequent eaters of vegetarian food?

choices.text: They are less likely to choose a vegetarian dish.
choices.zh: 他们不太可能选择素食菜品。

choices.text: They find vegetarian dishes become more appealing.
choices.zh: 他们发现素食菜品变得更有吸引力。

choices.text: They tend to consume larger portions of unhealthy food.
choices.zh: 他们倾向于食用更大份量的不健康食物。

choices.text: They are less likely to choose dishes recommended by chefs.
choices.zh: 他们不太可能选择厨师推荐的菜品。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Nottingham Trent University and the Chinese Academy of Sciences?

choices.text: They have found a solution to the global problem of air pollution.
choices.zh: 它们找到了解决全球空气污染问题的方案。

choices.text: They have managed to freeze polluting particles to around –18 °C.
choices.zh: 它们成功地将污染颗粒冷冻到零下18摄氏度左右。

choices.text: They have been seeking a way to prevent pollutants from penetrating indoors.
choices.zh: 它们一直在寻求防止污染物渗入室内的方法。

choices.text: They have been cooperating closely on developing a new type of air-conditioner.
choices.zh: 它们一直在密切合作研发一种新型空调。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about existing technologies to purify indoor air?

choices.text: They can be costly and inefficient.
choices.zh: 它们可能成本高昂且效率低下。

choices.text: They are constantly being perfected.
choices.zh: 它们正在不断完善。

choices.text: They are by-products of health research.
choices.zh: 它们是健康研究的副产品。

choices.text: They can save over 40,000 lives each year.
choices.zh: 它们每年可以挽救超过四万人的生命。

items.stem: What do people tend to do when outdoor air quality is poor?

choices.text: They keep their windows closed.
choices.zh: 他们关闭窗户。

choices.text: They spend a lot more time indoors.
choices.zh: 他们在室内待的时间更长。

choices.text: They make more use of air-conditioners.
choices.zh: 他们更多地使用空调。

choices.text: They try various ways to purify indoor air.
choices.zh: 他们尝试各种方法净化室内空气。

items.stem: What did Professor Gang Pan of the Chinese Academy of Sciences say about their study?

choices.text: It shows the importance of eliminating indoor pollution.
choices.zh: 它显示了消除室内污染的重要性。

choices.text: It may change the way of future environmental research.
choices.zh: 它可能改变未来环境研究的方式。

choices.text: It demonstrates the fruitful cooperation between UK and Chinese scientists.
choices.zh: 它展示了中英科学家之间富有成效的合作。

choices.text: It may make household appliances serve an additional air cleaner function.
choices.zh: 它可能使家用电器发挥额外的空气净化功能。

items.stem: What do we learn about the well-known mirror test?

choices.text: It distinguishes different species of animals.
choices.zh: 它可以区分不同的动物物种。

choices.text: It reflects distinct traits in animal behavior.
choices.zh: 它反映了动物行为的不同特征。

choices.text: It demonstrates animals' ability to recognize themselves.
choices.zh: 它展示了动物识别自身的能力。

choices.text: It gauges the level of intelligence of various animal species.
choices.zh: 它衡量各种动物物种的智力水平。

items.stem: What does the study by the speaker's team show about the fish they experimented with?

choices.text: It meets few of the behavioral criteria set in the mirror test.
choices.zh: 它仅符合镜像测试中设定的少数几项行为标准。

choices.text: It behaves similarly to animals capable of self-recognition.
choices.zh: 它的行为与能够自我识别的动物相似。

choices.text: It removes marks from itself to show self-awareness.
choices.zh: 它通过清除自身的标记来表现自我意识。

choices.text: It matches children over 18 months in intelligence.
choices.zh: 它的智力相当于超过18个月的儿童。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the results of their research?

choices.text: They have conclusively established the criteria of animal intelligence.
choices.zh: 他们已经确凿地确立了评判动物智力的标准。

choices.text: They have advanced the concept of self-awareness to a higher level.
choices.zh: 他们将自我意识这一概念提升到了更高的层次。

choices.text: They incorporate more perspectives than one.
choices.zh: 他们包含了不止一种观点。

choices.text: They raise more questions than answers.
choices.zh: 它们引发的问题多于给出的答案。

items.stem: What finding from the new study might come as a huge surprise?

choices.text: Small children are even more keen on screens than their elders.
choices.zh: 小孩子甚至比他们的长辈更热衷于屏幕。

choices.text: Both parents and children preferred to read electronic books.
choices.zh: 父母和孩子都更喜欢阅读电子书。

choices.text: Parents differed from children in reading behavior.
choices.zh: 父母的阅读行为与孩子不同。

choices.text: Children reading electronic books learned more.
choices.zh: 阅读电子书的孩子学到的东西更多。

items.stem: What do we learn about previous studies of young children reading electronic books?

choices.text: They came to conflicting conclusions.
choices.zh: 它们得出了相互矛盾的结论。

choices.text: They were based on small samples.
choices.zh: 它们以小规模样本为基础。

choices.text: They yielded unanticipated findings.
choices.zh: 它们得出了出乎意料的结果。

choices.text: They were focused on younger kids.
choices.zh: 它们关注的是年龄更小的孩子。

items.stem: What extra features should be included in electronic books to bolster children's learning?

choices.text: Those that prove simple enough for them to comprehend.
choices.zh: 那些足够简单、便于他们理解的功能。

choices.text: Those that produce both audio and visual effects on them.
choices.zh: 那些能同时对他们产生听觉和视觉效果的功能。

choices.text: Those that draw their attention to the educational content.
choices.zh: 那些能将他们的注意力吸引到教育内容上的功能。

choices.text: Those that contribute to their increased interest in reading.
choices.zh: 那些有助于提高他们阅读兴趣的功能。

items.stem: What should we do with the unfavorable decisions we've made?

choices.text: Regret having wasted much time in making them.
choices.zh: 后悔在作出这些决定时浪费了很多时间。

choices.text: Think how different we could have made them.
choices.zh: 想想我们本可以把这些决定变得多么不同。

choices.text: Keep ourselves from regretting them.
choices.zh: 不要让自己后悔这些决定。

choices.text: Live with them for the time being.
choices.zh: 暂时接受这些决定。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about every single decision we've ever made?

choices.text: It has made us the person we are now.
choices.zh: 它造就了如今的我们。

choices.text: It has been made with a lot of thinking.
choices.zh: 它是在经过深思熟虑后作出的。

choices.text: It stems from our valuable knowledge.
choices.zh: 它源于我们宝贵的知识。

choices.text: It benefits us greatly one way or another.
choices.zh: 无论以何种方式，它都对我们大有裨益。

items.stem: What is life full of according to the speaker?

choices.text: Challenging things to do.
choices.zh: 需要去做的具有挑战性的事情。

choices.text: Beautiful things to share.
choices.zh: 值得分享的美好事物。

choices.text: Choices to make.
choices.zh: 需要作出的选择。

choices.text: Lessons to learn.
choices.zh: 需要吸取的教训。

items.stem: What is said to be of real importance when we make poor decisions in life?

choices.text: Foreseeing the possibility for regret later.
choices.zh: 预见日后可能产生的悔意。

choices.text: Making proper use of the lessons learned.
choices.zh: 恰当地利用所吸取的教训。

choices.text: Perfecting the decision-making strategies.
choices.zh: 完善决策策略。

choices.text: Seeing them as obstacles to moving forward.
choices.zh: 把它们视为继续前进的障碍。
